sloka: एवं तद्वाक्यमुक्त्वा च सैनिकान्रघुनन्दनः ।अभिवाद्य महर्षिं तं स्वं निवेशं ययौ तदा ।। ७.७१.२४ ।।
transliteration: evaṁ tadvākyamuktvā ca sainikānraghunandanaḥ ।abhivādya maharṣiṁ taṁ svaṁ niveśaṁ yayau tadā ।। 7.71.24 ।।

translations.english: Having thus spoken that statement to the soldiers, Shatrughna then saluted the great sage and returned to his own camp. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे एकसप्ततिमः सर्गः ।। 71 ।। Thus ends the seventy-first sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
